verdict.rationale: The evidence covers developer building blocks: automatic embedding generation, hybrid and vector search, an inference API that passes settings to OpenAI chat completions, and RAG as a use case. None of it documents an in-product feature that surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions about a user's data. Building blocks for constructing such a feature earn no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
